title: The August Morning Bertha Benz Drove the Motor Car to Pforzheim
conflicts: Distance: about 100 km (DPMA), 106 km one way (National Motor Museum, Qatar Museums), 180 km return (Mercedes-Benz), 194 km memorial route; story says roughly 100 km one way. Sons' ages 15 and 14 (Mercedes-Benz) versus 15 and 13 (DPMA); story says teenage sons. Single-source anecdotes (the note left for Carl, his telegram about the chains, the Munich gold medal) left out; the company archive's own word 'legendary' is used for the road repairs.
notes: Bertha credited as co-founder in the founder field and the story because her dowry financed Carl's business (DPMA, Mercedes-Benz Classic archive, Qatar Museums); her formal legal status in Benz & Cie. is not claimed. Funding set to mixed rather than the slate's bootstrapped because Benz & Cie. had business partners besides the family money. Britannica and Hagerty are blocked for the verifier and are not cited. Quote stance: affirms.
